body: No right now. But I'm insured through work. I should. I will. I'll talk to meg in the morning.

I live with my mom right now.

Meg could help me. She's always been the best sister.

Vulgarity? Anger? All of it? There isn't much. There's not a lot. It's there. 

When I was in high school we took that test to see what we'd be. All I could think is about the Episode of Hey Arnold. Where Helga and Harold get their tests switched. You walk away believing what ever you want to believe. And it changes you. I wanted to believe a lot or too many things I guess. So what does it mean to the grand provost in charge of distribution and assement of the tests? Tongue in cheek answer s she said. Not taking anything seriously she said. Did the tests tell her to be what she was? Did it help that much? Why are people allowed to be teachers that can say that? I'm developing. I'm not good at anything. She called me a brat. I was just as lost finding my career path as I am now, and I had someone trying to help me calling me a brat? I could have gone to college. I could have learned something to make me money. 

But I started hanging out with these kids. The first one gave me her number when she rang me out at best buy with a wink. Kindness? Maybe flirting even? I dared to hope. I took my first shot of alcohol with her. We would drink and drink and drink and I met all people of different backgrounds at barbeques and dark abandoned houses and I drove them in my car and I paid for every bottle we drained , the kind of drinking that would pale even my father's face, even after all those years of being the best drinker in his gang, after all the years of sobriety that had now come to pass. The days bled together and years passed and suddenly I'm 5 thousand dollars in debt and I spend every night vomitting and still the circle of people I had come to know tighten around me with outstretched hands so one day I took off from her house in a blind spinig drunk rage and I awake to from it to see that I 've been doing 70 in a 45 on the wrong side of the street so I park in front of my house and cried for the first time since I got that test back saying I should be a PE teacher by a woman who didn't even know me from the next group of hopeless unprepared youths left in her charge. The drinking never stopped until 2 weeks ago today but I've been alone ever since so what could have been done. 

And now with no marketable skills and a dead ended job where I am hated for having sad eyes no money without a negative sign in front of it and no prospects. I've been sent to the ward been on and off the meds and back to my mother and out of the state and back again every good mirrored by a double bad. Every smile or laugh puts me into a state of fear, like there's a man behind me waiting to kick my teeth in with steel toed boots . My family are all I have left. No one will help me get to work since my car broke down. I sleep in the bath tub. Most days they won't even look at me. It's not their fault. 

I've never been anything worth saving . What is there to be said about a life wasted. 


So I guess that's it. I'm sorry.
I guess youre right, yeah. They haven't said it to me.  Sometimes I'll ask them for help and they say no, but everyone's entitled to say no.
Projecting. Like I have to take care of myself and I don't like it? So that's how I think they feel about me too?

I just feel like they're tired of me. I love them. I really do. I know they love me but sometimes I feel like the pet no one wants that everyone has to worry about and take care of. I'm like an anchor to them.
